QF.id: XIII Trading, Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_34

question.text: What is the purpose of the IRRA (Investor Risk Reduction Access) platform in the equity derivatives segment?

answer.text: IRRA is a joint exchange facility that lets investors square off or close their open positions and cancel pending orders when their trading member's trading services are disrupted due to technical glitches or outages
IRRA is a risk analytics platform that provides real-time margin calculations and portfolio risk metrics to retail investors
IRRA allows investors to reduce their risk by automatically converting futures positions into options positions during high volatility
IRRA is an insurance platform that compensates investors for losses incurred due to exchange system failures

explanation.text: The Logic: IRRA is a joint exchange platform that allows investors to square off or close their open positions and cancel pending orders when their trading member faces disruption of trading services due to technical glitches or outages. It provides an emergency exit channel directly through the exchange. The Trap: IRRA is not a risk analytics tool, an auto-conversion strategy engine, or an insurance scheme — its sole purpose is to give clients an alternative way to reduce open exposure during a trading-member service disruption. Note: The IRRA trigger that the workbook describes is disruption of the trading member's trading services; only closing/square-off actions and order cancellations are supported.
